summary: This chore represents a duplicant's action of finding and consuming an oxygen source, such as an oxygen canister, to replenish their bionic oxygen tank.  It utilizes a state machine to manage the different stages of the chore, from searching for a source to consuming its contents.  The chore's criticality determines its priority; critical chores take precedence over personal needs.  It interacts with `BionicOxygenTankMonitor` to manage the oxygen tank and its available space.  The chore handles various scenarios, including the case where the oxygen source is lost during the process.

keyMethods.name: FindAndConsumeOxygenSourceChore
keyMethods.description: Constructor. Initializes the chore based on whether it's critical and sets up preconditions.

parameters.name: critical
parameters.description: Indicates if the chore is critical (high priority).

keyMethods.name: Begin
keyMethods.description: Starts the chore. Finds the closest oxygen source and updates the state machine with relevant information.

keyMethods.name: IsNotAllowedByScheduleAndChoreIsNotCritical
keyMethods.description: Checks if the chore is allowed by the schedule and is not critical.

keyMethods.name: IsAllowedBySchedule
keyMethods.description: Checks if the chore is allowed based on the schedule.

keyMethods.name: IsCriticalChore
keyMethods.description: Checks if the chore is critical.

keyMethods.name: ExtractOxygenFromItem
keyMethods.description: Extracts oxygen from the consumed item and adds it to the duplicant's oxygen tank, handling gases and solids differently.
